surface_follow.label: Follow surfaces
surface_follow.description: Dragging moves the view center along terrain and object surfaces. Turn it off to keep the current height and pass through obstacles.

sky_time.label: Sky time
sky_time.description: Holds the sky and the sun at an hour of the place you are looking at, in its solar time. Clouds and stored data keep the real clock. A reload returns to the real time.

morning.label: Morning, 9:00
morning.description: The sun stands at a slant.

noon.label: Noon
noon.description: The sun at its highest, the shortest shadows.
